summary: Iteration 2 regression pass after code-review fixes (useCallback wrappings, console.error in catches, use-toast dep change). Backend: created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (41 tests, 40 pass) covering auth+cookie flags, RBAC, suppliers, medicines CRUD, suggest privacy, logs create/assign/delete, per-user log scoping, exports text/PDF, CSV+paste import, 404/400 edge cases. Frontend: full Playwright e2e for admin login->kanban, date-picker reload, session restore on refresh, quick-add via autocomplete, copy-for-WhatsApp (clipboard verified), PDF download, Medicine DB search/add/edit/delete, Settings supplier+user creation, employee autocomplete->quantity->save->delete, supplier privacy on employee page, role guard, logout, keyboard drag-and-drop with persistence, mobile 390px layout. NO regressions found: zero console errors, zero React warnings, no render loops. Only gap is a missing brute-force lockout (playbook requirement).

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no rate limit/lockout (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails -> 429/423). Security gap, unlimited credential stuffing possible.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True. Preflight from an arbitrary origin (https://evil.example.com) returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' and no allow-credentials header. Same-origin preview works, but this is both a security smell and will break credentialed cross-origin calls. Set explicit origins (FRONTEND_URL) instead of '*'.

Deletes supplier and nulls medicines.default_supplier_id but leaves existing logs pointing at the removed supplier_id; such logs then render in a generic 'Unknown' kanban column and export as 'Unknown'. Consider reassigning those logs to unassigned.
Known LOW from iteration 1 (accepted): quantity must be a string; integer payloads 422. Unchanged.

issues: Date filter uses the native browser <input type="date"> picker (data-testid=date-picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component available in components/ui — inconsistent with the rest of the custom design system.
Placeholder text (#9-ish grey on #F9F8F6) is very light; borderline WCAG AA for placeholder legibility.
With 6+ supplier columns the last column is off-screen with only horizontal scroll and no visual scroll affordance — verified data is correct, but users may not realise more columns exist.

action_items: Add login rate limiting / account lockout (e.g. 5 failed attempts -> 429 with cooldown) on POST /api/auth/login.
Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with explicit origin list since allow_credentials=True.
Optional: on supplier delete, reset affected logs to unassigned instead of leaving orphaned supplier_id ('Unknown' column).
Optional cleanup: remove now-unnecessary eslint-disable in src/hooks/use-toast.js:147 (ESLint reports it as an unused directive).
Optional: swap native date input for shadcn Calendar on the admin board; fix react/no-unescaped-entities lint errors in AdminHome/EmployeeHome/Login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~610 lines and mixes auth, medicines, imports, logs and PDF rendering — split into routers (auth/medicines/logs/export) before it grows further.

Auth verified against playbook: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$, login sets HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie, seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes, /auth/me honours Bearer fallback, logout clears cookie and localStorage and subsequent /auth/me is 401. Only missing playbook item is brute-force lockout.

Hook-dependency refactor is clean: no react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings from ESLint, and runtime showed no repeated network calls/render loops on AdminHome, MedicineDatabase, Settings, EmployeeHome, AuthContext.
AdminHome.onDragEnd optimistic update correctly rolls back via load() on failure; verified drag persists after reload.

rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force failure: /api/auth/login has no attempt counter or rate limiter — verify_password simply returns 401 each time, so 6 consecutive bad passwords produced [401 x6]. Reproduce: POST /api/auth/login with a valid email and wrong password 6 times; expect 429/423 on the 6th. Mitigation: track failed attempts per email+IP in Mongo (or an in-process limiter such as slowapi) and return 429 with a cooldown window, resetting on successful login.
